# Client terminal for Bakuryu

Client terminal for backup upload server

# Usage
Create .env file in root directory with the following content:
```
URL_SERVER=http://0.0.0.0:8181
TOKEN_SECRET=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..anbHFr1WgMi4l-8FYoneVAmSG7h6LN6xTsD0nWtXBfs
```
# Run the program
```
deno install
```
```
deno dev run --help
```
# Task
```
deno task
```
